text: The Contractor shall furnish all managerial, administrative, and direct labor personnel that are necessary to accomplish the work in this contract.

citations.quote:
The Contractor shall furnish all managerial, administrative, and direct labor personnel 
that are necessary to accomplish the work in this contract.

text: Contractor employees shall be on site only for contractual duties and not for other business purposes.

citations.quote:
Contractor employees shall be 
on site only for contractual duties and not for other business purposes.

text: The Contractor shall prepare general instructions for the work force and provide drafts to the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for review within thirty days after contract award.

citations.quote: The Contractor shall prepare general instructions for the work force.

The Contractor 
shall provide drafts to the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for review within 
thirty days after contract award.

text: Contractor will be responsible for providing individually packed lunch and dinner meals for seven people per day (98 meals per week), and shall schedule cooking, packaging, and delivery requirements to ensure the availability of daily meals as specified.

citations.quote:
Contractor shall schedule cooking and delivery requirements to ensure that these 
are done in the order and time frame specified.

Contractor will be responsible for providing individually packed lunch and dinner 
meals for seven people per day (98 meals per week).

Contractor will utilize its own operation hours for preparation, packaging, and 
delivery of food to ensure that (1) lunch and (1) dinner meal is available daily for 
seven people.

text: Contractor may use discretion on when to transport meals (three times a week or multiple days per trip) to the residence in Tallinn to minimize daily transportation.

citations.quote:
Contractor will use own discretion on when to transport meals to the residence in 
Tallinn.
Request is to deliver three times a week.

Contractor is encouraged to transport multiple day’s meals every trip to minimize 
daily transportation of meals.

text: The Contractor will be responsible for removing used food containers and any uneaten meals from the MSGR and disposing of them at contractor facilities during meal deliveries.

citations.quote:
Contractor will be responsible for removing used food containers and any uneaten 
meals from the MSGR and disposing of them at contractor facilities during meal 
deliveries.

text: The Contractor shall provide a supervisor as the main point of contact with U.S. Government personnel, who shall have sufficient English language skill to communicate with the staff.

citations.quote:
This supervisor shall be the focal point for the Contractor and shall be the point of 
contact with U.S. Government personnel.

The supervisor shall have sufficient English 
language skill to be able to communicate with members of the U.S. Government staff.

text: The Contractor shall maintain schedules that take into consideration the hours that staff can effectively perform services without burdening Post security personnel.

citations.quote: The Contractor shall maintain schedules.

The schedules shall take into 
consideration the hours that the staff can effectively perform their services without 
placing a burden on the security personnel of the Post.

text: The Contractor shall be responsible for quality control, performing regular surprise inspection visits to the work site, and coordinating these visits with the COR.

citations.quote: The Contractor shall be responsible for quality control.

The Contractor shall 
perform inspection visits to the work site on a regular basis.

The Contractor shall 
coordinate these visits with the COR.

These visits shall be surprise inspections to those 
working on the contract.

citations.quote: Submit signed and dated offers to the office specified in this solicitation at or before the exact time specified in this solicitation.

text: As a minimum, offers shall include the solicitation number, offeror contact details, UEI and EFT indicators, information to evaluate factors, completed representations and certifications, a statement of agreement with terms, and a completed SF-1449 cover page and Section 1.

citations.quote: As a minimum, offers shall include--
The solicitation number;
As a minimum, offers shall include--
The name, address, telephone number of the Offeror;
As a minimum, offers shall include--

The Offeror’s Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and, if applicable, Electronic 
Funds Transfer (EFT) indicator;
As a minimum, offers shall include--

Information necessary to evaluate the factors contained in the provision at 
52.212-2 or as described in the solicitation;
As a minimum, offers shall include--

Responses to provisions that require Offeror completion of information, 
representations, and certifications (other than those collected via the System for 
Award Management (SAM)); and
As a minimum, offers shall include--

A statement specifying the extent of agreement with all terms, conditions, and 
provisions included in the solicitation and any solicitation amendments.

A completed solicitation, in which the SF-1449 cover page (blocks 12, 17, 19-24, and 30 as 
appropriate), and Section 1 has been filled out.

text: If providing the service requires special licenses or permits, the offeror shall address its plan to obtain them or provide a copy of already possessed locally required licenses and permits.

citations.quote:

If offeror already possesses the 
locally required licenses and permits, a copy shall be provided.
